S.press.title: Kayan ’yan jarida na Lewydo
S.press.lead: Duk abin da kake bukata don rubuta game da Lewydo ko yin bidiyo game da wasanninmu: bayanai, labarinmu, tambari da kayan ’yan jarida na kowane wasanmu. Kyauta ne a yi amfani da su a rubuce-rubucenka.
S.press.fact.whoV: Studio na wasanni mai zaman kansa, na mutum biyu, daga Ukraine
S.press.fact.langsV: {n}, a kowane wasa da kuma a wannan shafin
S.studio.title: Mutum biyu, zuciya ɗaya
S.cp:about: Lewydo ƙaramin kamfanin wasanni ne na mutum biyu daga Ukraine. Vlad yana rubuta code, Lilya tana zayyana. Tare muna yin wasannin da mu kanmu muke son yi.
S.story.brand.d: Vlad koyaushe yana ƙare rubuce-rubucensa na [Medium](https://veldan1202.medium.com/) game da LibGDX, Android da Kotlin a hanya ɗaya: «Love what you do» da zuciya kore 💚. Wannan sa hannun ya zama alamarmu.
S.story.3.d: Mai ƙirƙira ya haɗu da mai zane. Kamfanin bai san yana nan ba tukuna.
S.story.idea.d: Vlad yana aiki a Rundunar Sojojin Ukraine. Wata safiya ya farka a gidan da rukuninsa ke zaune lokacin wani aiki — da ra'ayin CubePix a kansa.
S.story.web.t: Yanar gizo ta zama ainihin dandamali
S.story.online.t: Orbit Dash ya shiga kan layi
S.press.games.sub: Kowane wasa yana da nasa kayan ’yan jarida, tare da hotunan allo, trailer da bayanansa.
S.od.tag: Da'ira biyu. Taɓawa ɗaya. Kowane tsalle a kan bugu.
S.pk.line.orbitdash: Wasan bugu a cikin sararin samaniya: taɓawa ɗaya tana canza da'ira, kuma kowane tsalle yana faɗowa a kan bugun kiɗanmu na kanmu.
S.pk.line.cubepix: Wasan wuyar warwarewa mai natsuwa ga masu son fasaha.
S.press.logo.title: Tambarin Lewydo
S.press.logo.sub: PNG masu haske, kai tsaye daga wasanninmu. Don Allah ka sanya alamar a kan bango mai duhu, kada ka canza launukanta ko girmanta.
S.press.kit: **Dukan kayan alama**: ƙa’idoji, launuka, haruffa, sautin Lewydo da code na wasanninmu.
S.press.use.title: Yadda ake amfani da waɗannan kayan
S.press.use.yes: Yi amfani da su a labarai, bita, bidiyo, kai-tsaye da rubuce-rubucen social media game da Lewydo da wasanninmu.
S.press.use.resize: Canza girman hotunan don su dace da tsarin shafinka.
S.press.use.no: Kada ka sake zana, ka canza launi ko ka miƙa tambarin, kuma kada ka yi amfani da shi don nuna haɗin gwiwa na hukuma.

S.press.follow.title: Bi Lewydo
S.press.follow.sub: Sababbin wasanni, sabuntawa da labarin da ke bayansu.
